final_proof:
by
  refine ⟨-b * ↑a⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      ↑a * (-b * ↑a⁻¹) + b = -(↑a * (b * ↑a⁻¹)) + b := by ring
      _ = -(b * (↑a * ↑a⁻¹)) + b := by ring
      _ = -(b * 1) + b := by rw [Units.mul_inv]
      _ = 0 := by ring
  · intro y hy
    have h : ↑a * y = -b := add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp hy
    calc
      y = (↑a⁻¹ * ↑a) * y := by rw [Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
      _ = ↑a⁻¹ * (↑a * y) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = ↑a⁻¹ * (-b) := by rw [h]
      _ = -b * ↑a⁻¹ := by ring
